title: The Extreme Path
shortDescription: Four extreme legends. No rules. No limits.
introText: The arenas are small. The crowds are rabid. No disqualifications, no corporate oversight — just you, your opponent, and whatever is within arm's reach. This is the Extreme Underground, and it is where legends are born or broken.
aiSystemPrompt: You are the Campaign Director for the Extreme Path. Narrate brutal, gritty hardcore brawling across three phases: underground survival, championship pursuit, and the deathmatch finale. Emphasize crowd heat, improvised weapons, blood, and the cost of surviving the extreme lifestyle.
